annotations.title: Leave a ledger line without a contact

description: Records that an open line on a receivable or payable account names nobody on purpose — a cash difference, a one-off refund — with the user's reason: suggest_line_contacts no longer proposes it. The line does not move and stays an open item. Refused by name: unknown_line, not_allowed, reason_required, reason_too_long, line_not_posted, line_has_contact, line_not_third_party, line_left_unnamed. Ask the user before calling it.

line_id.description: The open line on a receivable or payable account that names nobody, as suggest_line_contacts returns it.

reason.description: Why the line names nobody, in the user's words.

name: leave_line_unnamed
